It has no breaking false positive, but cannot reach verified: ioredis 6 keeps v5 reply shapes and types for default clients and removes no command, so none of the five upgrades has a compiler diagnostic or another breaking site to predict; their source changes are connection-default decisions (protocol: 2, the v5 retryStrategy, the HELLO 3 AUTH redaction test), which are behavior notes. The one breaking compile error found (bullmq 5 bundling its own ioredis 5, elie222/inbox-zero) disappears in a real install because that workspace forces one ioredis copy, and its upgrade also moved bullmq 5 to 6, a separate major. Checked 2026-10-14. Retry when a public upgrade has a breaking ioredis 6 site (a bundled-copy type error fixed in the commit, a subscriber mode check, a connect listener with enableOfflineQueue: false), or when the gate can count behavior-note findings.

requested in UPT-56: declared in every repository of the 2026-10-14 OSS sample scan, most on 5.x; the compiler itself, so no type diff measures it: the 6.0 release notes (https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/release-notes/typescript-6-0.html) deprecate baseUrl, moduleResolution node and classic, target ES5, module amd/umd/system/none, outFile, downlevelIteration, esModuleInterop and alwaysStrict false, module-keyword namespaces and import assertions, and change the strict, types, rootDir, module, target and noUncheckedSideEffectImports defaults; not measured

split 2026-10-14 from the 5 to 6 entry above: 6.0 deprecates what 7.0 removes (Announcing TypeScript 7.0, 2026-07-08, https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-7-0/), so a 5.x repository goes through 6 first; 7.0 also makes stableTypeOrdering permanent, changes template literal inference on Unicode code points and drops JSDoc Closure-style function types; not measured
queue.blockedReason: TypeScript 7.0 ships no JavaScript compiler API (typescript@7.0.2 exports only lib/version.cjs; the announcement says a new API comes with 7.1), so `check` cannot compute the target's diagnostics: compileCompilerUpgrade reports the compile as not done and only tsconfig findings would remain. Retry when typescript 7.x exposes a programmatic API check can load, or when check can run the target's tsc binary on the repository without executing repository code.
